Nike's fiscal Q4 2026 runs roughly March–May 2026, and I don't have its reported results. My best estimate for cost of sales is about **$6.6 billion**. This is an extrapolation, not a reported figure.

The estimate rests on these points:
- **Prior-year quarter:** In fiscal Q4 2025, Nike reported revenue of about $11.1 billion and a gross margin of 40.3%. That implies cost of sales of about $6.6 billion.
- **Recent trend:** Through fiscal 2026, revenue has been roughly flat to slightly up, and gross margin has been pressured by tariffs. I assumed revenue of about $11.2 billion and a gross margin of about 41% for the quarter.
- **Result:** $11.2 billion × (1 − 0.41) ≈ $6.6 billion.
